subject.title: fix(skills): forward owner handle to bulk security-verdict fetch for ambiguous slugs

question: Should OpenClaw add a bounded per-item owner-qualified verify fallback when bulk security verdicts return `skill_not_found`, or wait for ClawHub to make the bulk endpoint owner-aware?
rationale: The PR’s sole behavioral premise is contradicted by the linked live bulk-API evidence, and choosing between an OpenClaw fallback and an external API dependency changes the long-term owner boundary and request behavior.

options.title: Add the bounded verify fallback
options.body: On an owner-qualified bulk `skill_not_found`, resolve that item through the supported owner-qualified verify endpoint and preserve the bulk result for all other items.

options.title: Wait for ClawHub bulk support
options.body: Pause this PR until ClawHub documents and demonstrates that its bulk verdict endpoint accepts and resolves `ownerHandle` per item.

recommendation.title: Add the bounded verify fallback
recommendation.body: On an owner-qualified bulk `skill_not_found`, resolve that item through the supported owner-qualified verify endpoint and preserve the bulk result for all other items.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision depends on ownership of the external ClawHub verdict API contract, for which no individual is established in the available evidence.
